messages:
maya: deploy-bot flagged a cross-region pin during the midnight rollout, pinging eng-releases for a quick sync. deploybot shows runtime=3.2 pinned for model=llama3q in eu-west. last deploy window ~00:15 UTC. unpin vs rollback call?

deploy-bot: [INFO] Pin applied: runtime=3.2 model=llama3q region=eu-west reason=compat-failure-md5 threshold=0.7. To unpin: `/deploy unpin --runtime 3.2 --region eu-west`

ashwin: seeing higher latencies in eu-west, telemetry confirms kv-cache misses +12% for longseq in the pinned cohort. leaning to keep pin while we triage. :thinking_face:

lina: can we revert the small runtime kernel hotpatch pushed at 00:10? that change touched cache-merge ordering and looks suspicious.

maya: ops would prefer avoiding a full rollback inside the change window. proposal: keep pin, set routing to send 10% traffic to fallback model `redwood-llama3q-v1` for critical customers, run quick smoke evals, then decide. Sean, can you add routing?

sean: will add a gradual reroute in 5m. also posting core dumps/metrics to #eng-sre for visibility.

ashwin: plan to run regression: `make smoke-eval MODEL=llama3q SEQ=4096 RUNTIME=3.1` and compute average logit divergence. if divergence > 0.02 -> rollback.

lina: agree. also check p95 and kv-miss deltas; a small divergence with big latency change still warrants kernel fix.

maya: timeline: 00:20 smoke-eval, 00:30 diff check, 00:40 decide unpin vs rollback. keeping pin as default for now.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Routing updated: eu-west: 10% -> redwood-llama3q-v1 (fallback). Pin remains active.

sean: routing applied and annotated in deploybot history. adding to release-notes draft: 'eu-west emergency pin; 10% fallback routing applied; investigating kv-cache regressions.'

maya: for audit/comm: create REL-7892 with logs, eval outputs, and a short timeline. cc @security if there are any concerns about customer data in traces.

ashwin: starting smoke-eval now, will paste results here when done.

ashwin: smoke-eval results: avg logit divergence = 0.007, p95 latency diff = +110ms, kv-miss rate delta = +11%.

lina: divergence < 0.02 so model outputs are near-identical, but latency and kv misses are concerning. recommendation: keep pin, schedule a targeted hotfix to adjust cache-merge ordering (non-rolling kernel tweak).

maya: agreed. carry pin through the change window, schedule hotfix rollforward in 3 hours, update release notes and customer comms placeholders. if hotfix fails, we'll rollback runtime patch.

sean: noted, adding hotfix rollout playbook to REL-7892 and flagging oncall. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks everyone — closing this huddle unless objections.

lina: no objections.

ashwin: no objections.

deploy-bot: [NOTE] Pin still active. Next automated escalation at +2h if no resolution.
